atomic_facts.fact: John Ternus's full name is John Patrick Ternus.
John Ternus became Apple's chief executive officer effective September 1, 2026.
As of September 30, 2026, John Ternus holds the title of Chief Executive Officer of Apple.
Prior to becoming CEO, John Ternus's position was Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering at Apple.
Apple issued an official press release announcing John Ternus as its next chief executive officer.
The press release was dated April 20, 2026.
The press release stated Ternus would become CEO effective September 1, 2026.
